questions.subject: भूगोल
questions.q: पश्चिमी युरोपको जलवायुमा उत्तर एटलान्टिक न्यानो धाराको प्रमुख प्रभाव के हो?

questions.solution: सही उत्तर: A — जाडो तुलनात्मक रूपमा न्यानो बनाउनु।

भू-आकृतिले वर्षाको वितरणमा प्रभाव पार्न सक्छ
नेपालका सबै स्थानमा वर्षाको मात्रा र समय बिल्कुल समान हुन्छ
questions.explanation: उचाइ, भू-आकृति र मनसुनी प्रणालीका कारण नेपालमा वर्षा र तापक्रमको स्थानगत भिन्नता हुन्छ।

questions.subject: भूगोल
questions.q: तलका मध्ये कुन भनाइ गलत छ?
options: Convergent boundary मा प्लेटहरू एकअर्कातर्फ सर्छन्
Divergent boundary मा प्लेटहरू अलग हुन सक्छन्
सबै भूकम्प केवल divergent boundary मै हुन्छन्
Transform boundary मा प्लेटहरू एकअर्काको समानान्तर दिशामा सर्न सक्छन्
questions.explanation: भूकम्प विभिन्न प्रकारका प्लेट सीमामा हुन सक्छन्; त्यसैले सबै भूकम्प divergent boundary मै हुन्छन् भन्ने भनाइ गलत हो।
questions.solution: सही उत्तर: D — सबै भूकम्प केवल divergent boundary मै हुन्छन्।

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: A four-person panel is selected from A, B, C, D, E and F. A and B cannot serve together. C must serve if D serves. E cannot serve if F serves. Which panel is valid?
questions.solution: B,C,D,E satisfies A-B restriction; D is accompanied by C; E is not paired with F.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Three statements are made: A says, 'B is lying.' B says, 'C is lying.' C says, 'A and B are both lying.' If exactly one person is telling the truth, who is truthful?
questions.solution: If B is truthful, C is lying and A is also lying, giving exactly one truthful speaker.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: In a ranking, R is above S but below T. U is below S but above V. Which order is necessarily correct from highest to lowest among these five?
questions.solution: T > R > S and S > U > V, so T, R, S, U, V is forced.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: A city experienced unusually heavy rainfall, followed by localized flooding in low-lying areas. Which is the most reasonable inference?
options: Flooding always occurs whenever it rains
Heavy rainfall can be a contributing cause of localized flooding
questions.solution: Heavy rainfall can exceed drainage capacity and contribute to flooding; the other options make unjustified absolute claims.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Assertion (A): A department should keep a backup of important digital records. Reason (R): Digital records can become inaccessible because of hardware failure or other technical problems.
options: Both A and R are true, and R correctly explains A
Both A and R are true, but R does not explain A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
questions.solution: Technical failure is a direct reason why backup copies are needed.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: An agency's emergency procurement records show repeated missing justifications. Which course is most appropriate first?
options: Review the cases, identify the control failure, and require documented justification
Ignore the issue because emergencies are unpredictable
questions.solution: A targeted review can identify the weakness and lead to corrective controls without abandoning necessary emergency procurement.

questions.question: Choose the best transformation: 'Despite being tired, she continued working.'
options: Although she tired, but she continued working.
Because she was tired, she stopped working.
Although she was tired, she continued working.
She continued working because she was tired.
questions.solution: Despite being tired can be expressed as Although she was tired.

questions.question: Choose the clearest sentence.
options: The officer reviewed the file carefully that contained errors.
The officer reviewed carefully the file contained errors.
The officer the file reviewed carefully that contained errors.
The officer carefully reviewed the file that contained errors.
questions.solution: The modifier carefully is naturally placed before the verb phrase, and the relative clause clearly modifies file.
